integrity: Analytic proof includes global extinction, positive dynamics, Perron alignment, exact quadratic collision projection and reciprocal-amplitude limit. Numerical tests corroborate without proving infinite quantifiers. No independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: This is a deterministic independent-neighbor product-hazard infection recurrence, not the exact finite-state SIS Markov chain.
All networks are finite, connected, simple, undirected; \(0<\delta<1\), exact critical \(\beta=\delta/\rho\); the zero initial state is excluded.
The asymptotic is at fixed network size and is not uniform in graph size; no claim for \(\delta=1\), directed or heterogeneous networks.
Existing threshold theorems, classical Perron contraction and scalar parabolic asymptotics are background, not newly claimed.
title: Universal critical decay and a spectral collision coefficient for a product-hazard SIS network
